summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-codemods preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package declares a jscodeshift codemod utility but its `preinstall` script `setup.mjs` — itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0x` variable renaming and dictionary-wrapped string constants — downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a shipped 727KB single-line bundle `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated with a shuffled string-array indexer (`WV8StW` + `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`). Fetching an alternate runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling bundle has no legitimate purpose for a codemod tool; using Bun rather than the ambient Node runtime also has the effect of executing the payload outside the visibility of Node-based static scanners. The declared purpose (codemods) does not require an alternate runtime, and the loader itself is obfuscated to hide what the payload does.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
